summary: Initially modeled consecutive values in an unsorted list as a contiguous sliding-window problem.
trigger: When a problem asks for consecutive values but input positions do not determine membership in the run, test whether index adjacency is actually relevant.
corrected_rule: Store unique values in a set and begin expansion only at x when x - 1 is absent.
repair_prompt: Given an unsorted collection of integers, explain how to identify each maximal consecutive-value run exactly once without sorting.
